subtitle: One chapter and one appendix, both numbered 1
description: A fixture for the claim-check path's appendix concept. The smallest book that reproduces the collision: chapter 1 and appendix 1 in one folder, both carrying provenance marks, so --emit-worklist has to tell them apart. Under the guide profile, since an appendix is a guide-profile kind and check-book.sh rejects the filename under narration.

Before an appendix was carried through as its own kind, it took its number from the filename's first digit run, emitted as chapter 1, and render-report.py refused the whole run with `index.json lists chapter number 1 more than once`, exiting 2 and writing nothing. `--chapters 1` also silently emitted the appendix, which is what made a scoped /updatebook re-check read a file the edit never touched.

Expected: check-book.sh exits 0; --emit-worklist exits 0 and writes one chapter entry and one appendix entry; render-report.py exits 0 and renders a row reading `appendix 1`. run.sh asserts all of it, including that a findings file in the old `"chapter": N` shape is named and skipped rather than counted. This is the fixture's only assertion beyond run.sh; update both in the same edit.
